about: I am an early-career data and business intelligence professional on the BI team at a microfinance bank in Lagos, with hands-on experience in reporting, data validation, process improvement and workflow automation.

My work involves turning raw data into business insight: cleaning and validating data, building dashboards, improving reporting processes, and spotting repetitive tasks that can be automated. I am deepening my automation skills with n8n, Make and Zapier through TS Academy's AI & Automation programme.
I enjoy solving business problems where analytical thinking, technology and process improvement meet.
